_doc: Every concrete mod Screen class (found in the jar at run time; a class missing from both lists fails 305). 'args' builds the constructor call: null | int:N | bool:B | str:S | float:F | enum:* (one screen per constant of that parameter's enum) | intconsumer | consumer (a no-op Consumer) | strlist:a|b (a List<String>) | screen:R (mod screen R built with a null parent) | pvtarget (ProfileViewerFeature.Target of a fixed name/UUID). 'factory' names a public static method to call instead (args apply to it). Constructor sources are mod 8c43a6d.
